## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant automated tests.
- [ ] I tested failure paths, not only the happy path.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, personal data, generated indexes, or `.env` files.
- [ ] I updated contracts and documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked that MongoDB, Redis, MCP, A2A, metrics, and guardrails remain consistent when affected.
- [ ] The commit messages use Conventional Commits and describe real logical increments.

## Risks and rollback

List operational, privacy, security, cost, or compatibility risks and explain how this change can be reverted safely.
